issues.title: The Squeaker
issues.caption: I was looking for the squeaker.
issues.alt: Bailey sits beside a torn couch cushion with stuffing on his nose. His owner holds the television remote.

issues.title: A Walk on Wheels
issues.caption: I said I wanted to GO for a walk.
issues.alt: Bailey rides in a red wagon with his front paws on the edge while his owner pulls it down the sidewalk.

issues.title: A Small Addition
issues.caption: We wanted kids, but the HOA only approved one small addition.
issues.alt: A homeowner proudly shows the neighbors a tiny traffic cone beside a larger cone in his driveway.

issues.title: The Missing Sock
issues.caption: After 48 hours, we put them on the cartons.
issues.alt: At a laundromat, a worried man holds a loose sock. An employee points to a milk carton with an image of its missing mate.

issues.title: Hard to Find
issues.caption: I’m organizing a hide-and-seek tournament. Good players are hard to find.
issues.alt: At a park table, a bearded man with a clipboard tells a joke to a bored man in a cap. Two shoes poke out from behind a large tree.

issues.title: Time Flies
issues.caption: I threw my watch out the window. I wanted to see time fly.
issues.alt: At a diner counter, a bearded man holds up a giant blue watch while his unimpressed friend sets down a cup of coffee.
